# Knowunity

> > Knowunity is an AI-powered educational platform offering 24/7 personalized tutoring, student-created study materials, and a creator program for content monetization.

Knowunity combines AI chat technology with crowdsourced educational content across subjects like AP Environmental Science, Biology, and Earth Science. The platform supports multilingual learning with step-by-step explanations, flashcards, and homework help, while enabling students and creators to share knowledge through TikTok and YouTube integrations.

## Key Topics

- AI Tutor
- Homework Help

- AP Environmental Science
- Creator Program

## Core Platform

- [AI Chat - Your Personal AI Tutor | Knowunity](https://knowunity.com): Homepage for Knowunity's 24/7 AI tutor with personalized learning support
- [Become a Creator - Knowunity](https://knowunity.com/creators): Creator program page for monetizing Knowunity content creation

## Environmental Science

- [Atmospheric Carbon and Greenhouse Effects](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/earth-and-geographic-sciences/atmospheric-carbon-and-greenhouse-effects-2): AP Environmental Science content on climate change and greenhouse gases
- [Atmospheric Layers and Ozone](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/earth-and-geographic-sciences/atmospheric-layers-and-ozone-2): Earth science guide to atmospheric layers from troposphere to exosphere
- [Aquatic Ecosystems and Biomes](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/earth-and-geographic-sciences/aquatic-ecosystems-and-biomes-2): Study guide covering freshwater and marine biomes and ecosystems
- [Agricultural Genetic Engineering](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/earth-and-geographic-sciences/agricultural-genetic-engineering-2): Educational content on GMOs and genetic modification in agriculture
- [Aquaculture Systems](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/earth-and-geographic-sciences/aquaculture-systems-2): Learning materials on marine farming and integrated aquaculture systems

## Biology

- [Mitosis](https://knowunity.com/knowledge/biology/reproductive-cell-cycles-2/mitosis-3): Study notes on mitosis and eukaryotic cell division (PMAT phases)
